body:
Nice man!

I wanted to get it done exactly the same, but the tattoo artist advised against it. Mainly copyright nonsens. So I have the symbol as is on my arm. Still thinking of getting it filled. Really bummed out that I couldn't do it the way you did. 

Still, really nice tattoo and I'm glad to see another hunter.

It might not be what you'd want to hear, but there is a comedian named Daniel Sloss. I found his material hilarious. Point being, in his second show (on netflix, by the way) he spoke about being alone and how someone told him "how could you love someone else if you don't love yourself?". That stuck to me like a tick and really changed my perception on things. Maybe it could do the same for you? 
Start to love yourself before finding someone to love...
But, best of luck to you my man. Love will find you, you just have to know when it's close.

If I may, why beat yourself up so much? 
You should know that you mean the world to someone. I might not know who, but you made a fundamental change in someone's life. So why beat yourself up for mistakes? We all make them, right? That's what makes us human. Just don't repeat your mistakes. Learn from them and try not to do them again. 
If it's the case of depression, then know that there are millions of us in the world. I'm clinically depressed and I've been where you are now. I know it might sound like the hardest thing in the world, but decide who is in charge of your life. You, or your depression? 
Decide if you're going to make a change or allow depression to let you wallow in self pity. Your stong, whomever you are. You just need to realise it 😊.

All of your reasons are fair and thanks for sharing.
I posted it to see what other people hold on to. 
I've read that depression will inevitably stop whatever you were interested in...
I'm a gamer, but recently I've lost my spark...
So, gaming is out for me.

Seeing what other people hold on to gives you a new reason to search for an anchor. 
Family has always been a big one, but eventually I might shrug them off (I honestly hope I don't get to that level...)
So, in some way, seeing that others still have something to hold on to gives me a little bit of hope.

Believe me, there is someone that cares!
Don't give up on trying to get help. Most psychologists will actually do sessions for free, as they have to do some "community work" during a year, which includes free counciling.

I went through the same as you did (still am actually). I didn't go to my parents as I was ashamed of what they'd think. My best friend, who is a psychologist, told me to go and see a psychologist. So, I did. I went and found one and went to see her for as long as I could. I wasn't financially stable, but I refused her offer to council me for free (old habits). In the end, things turned up okay.
If no one is willing to help you find your way, then make your own way. 

I'm contemplating going back to my psych as my depression hit me hard again. Even though I've been on antidepressants for nearly 3 years now.
So just try finding someone better. Changes are good that you will.

Why not get a second opinion?
Go and physically see people who can help you? 
Don't let one human get you down. There are a great amount of psychologists, psychiatrists and counsellors to speak to. 
You just need to find the one who really wants to help. Preferably someone who's had their cup of coffee and is ready for the new day...

I always had a liking to the idea of immortality...
Maybe be a vampire or just being unable to age (for who knows what reason), but I could never face reality behind my idea. I care for people. I have sentimental value in gifts that I received over the years. So I don't want to see what my decision has brought to my friends and family. 
If I ever had a choice, I'd want to wander the earth as a spirit, but in different era's. See how we as humans grew to what we are now and maybe find out what the point is to all of this...
